metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the sci-paper scientific writing + review + ideation plugin.

plugins.name: sci-paper
plugins.description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). Ships 10 skills and 22 tools under one typed scientific-writing standard: source-traced integrity blockers, zero-target L0, ranked advisories, explicit measurement states, claim-faithful rewriting with a hard length budget, isolated multi-review orchestration, and a funding-proposal editing mode. See CHANGELOG.md for per-version history.
